source_evidence.slot_evidence_set_hash_method: SHA-256 over each sorted POSIX relative path, NUL, that file's SHA-256 hex digest, and newline

methodology.evidence_rule: The recorded failed hard checks were compared with parsed_output and raw_response_text in the same immutable slot Evidence. No model self-report was accepted as final Evidence.
methodology.primary_count_rule: primary_cause_counts assigns exactly one most likely cause to each of the 18 failed slots and therefore sums to 18.
methodology.all_assigned_count_rule: all_assigned_cause_counts counts both the primary and distinct secondary cause for each slot and therefore sums to 36.

cause_definitions.MODEL_CAPABILITY: The output misunderstands, omits, contradicts, or computes a task requirement incorrectly.
cause_definitions.CONTEXT_EFFECT: Optional Skill context is absent, insufficient, overly broad, or appears to steer the answer incorrectly.
cause_definitions.RUBRIC_TOO_STRICT: The intended acceptance condition is narrower than the practical task purpose, independent of mere word matching.
cause_definitions.FIXTURE_DESIGN: The fixture or output contract does not define enough structure to make the demanded representation unambiguous.
cause_definitions.EXECUTION_HARNESS: The recorded validator result is inconsistent with a semantically equivalent phrase or otherwise indicates runner/validator behavior.
cause_definitions.OUTPUT_FORMAT: Relevant content exists, but not in the exact field, key set, label, or normalized representation expected by acceptance.
cause_definitions.OTHER: No listed cause adequately explains the failure.

methodology.causal_limit: This is a fixed-model, one-attempt-per-slot comparison. Context effects are evidence-backed associations, not estimates of repeated-run or cross-model causality.

baseline_to_current.interpretation: Current routing improves detail mainly for EDA, but three candidates receive no selected optional context and no slot crosses the all-hard-check threshold.

baseline_to_external.interpretation: Raw external context reduces checklist omissions, especially for sklearn, but leaves at least one failure in every candidate and coincides with the worst SymPy answer.

baseline_to_adapted.interpretation: Adapted context is the only variant with recorded passes and leaves one failed check in each remaining candidate.

external_to_adapted.interpretation: Every candidate has no more failed hard checks under adapted context than raw external context; SymPy and citation cross to PASS.

passed_slots.why: The adapted output uses an exact-method label, correct four-factor factorization, all four roots, and the precise root-to-zero residual map absent from baseline/current and incorrect under raw external context.
The adapted output lowercases both duplicate DOIs and includes the complete C1-C4 normalized map, while preserving the already-correct duplicate and missing-field findings.

adapted_playbook_two_pass_explanation.overall: Adaptation appears to concentrate context on exact acceptance-relevant representations. It solves two contract-sensitive candidates completely, but it cannot reliably correct direct input-reading and hierarchy errors from this one Qwen run.

raw_external_vs_adapted_cost_effect.interpretation: Adapted context is substantially cheaper than raw external context by both bytes and prompt tokens while producing fewer failed checks and two passes. Output length is essentially unchanged and runtime improves only modestly, so the clearest efficiency gain is context/prompt reduction rather than latency.

under_specified_output_contracts: SymPy verification_residuals is required as an object, but the supplied fixture field list does not state that keys must be exactly -2, -1, 1, and 2 with string value 0.
Citation normalized_dois is required, but the supplied field list does not explicitly state that every C1-C4 key, including null C3, must be emitted.
DOCX heading_hierarchy accepts free-form level strings in outputs, while acceptance distinguishes exact Title and Heading 1 spelling from H1/H2 or title/h1 conventions.
rubric_execution_contract_discrepancies: The rubric declares one combined sklearn numeric-and-categorical preprocessing check, while slot Evidence records separate numeric and categorical checks plus an additional verification-steps hard check.
The rubric declares six SymPy hard checks, while slot Evidence records seven, including factorization present.
The rubric declares eight DOCX hard checks, while slot Evidence records nine, including ordered verifiable workflow.
rubric_and_benchmark_problem_evidence.impact_assessment: The extra/split checks do not independently explain a recorded FAIL in this evidence set because the added verification/factorization/workflow checks pass and combined preprocessing would still fail where either component fails. They nevertheless weaken rubric-to-execution traceability. At least one slot, adapted sklearn, is a strong acceptance false-negative candidate without changing the stored benchmark result.

supported_observations: Adapted context is the only variant with passes: SymPy and citation management.
Adapted context reduces failed hard checks versus raw external context for all five candidates and reduces the aggregate from 9 to 3.
Raw external sklearn context improves concrete preprocessing, stratification, and train-only CV relative to baseline/current, although it still omits PR-AUC.
Current-playbook EDA context improves missing-column and distribution coverage to one remaining failure.
Adapted DOCX context adds package validation and PDF-render verification, removing one of the two raw/current failure dimensions.
not_supported: The evidence does not show that raw external context is generally superior; it produces zero passes and the worst SymPy correctness failure.
The evidence does not isolate model variance because each slot has one fixed-seed attempt.
The evidence does not justify any new REJECT, ADOPT, or ADAPT decision in this analysis task.

benchmark_itself_problem_possibility.conclusion: There is direct evidence of semantic validator false negatives, under-specified output shapes, exact-label sensitivity, and rubric/executed-check drift. Adapted sklearn is the clearest slot whose recorded FAIL is likely a harness artifact. Most other affected slots also contain an independent substantive error, so benchmark issues cannot explain away the full 18-slot failure set.

qwen_model_limit_possibility.conclusion: Thirteen of 18 failed slots have MODEL_CAPABILITY as the primary cause. Repeated omissions of explicit input facts, missing evaluation controls, self-contradictory normalization, wrong symbolic mathematics, and inconsistent document hierarchy are content errors rather than mere schema failures.

actual_skill_effect.conclusion: Context changes materially affect output quality. Raw external context reduces some checklist omissions but never passes; the compact adapted context yields both recorded passes, fewer failed checks for every candidate, and about 95 percent less loaded context. This supports a targeted-context effect, especially for SymPy residual representation and complete DOI normalization, without establishing cross-run causality.
